Wrote a NEW independent suite /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_public_review.py (47 tests) that drives everything through the PUBLIC ingress URL (https://reclaim-verify.preview.emergentagent.com) and verifies persisted state directly in MongoDB: 44 passed, 3 failed (2 real defects). SECRETS: no secret string (key_secret / webhook_secret) appears in ANY response (GET /api/integrations, PUT response, /api/webhooks/config, /api/integrations/razorpay/events) or in the rendered DOM; only key_id_masked 'rzp_test_********'. Health counts cross-checked against provider_events + security_events in MongoDB and match. test-connection returns honest ERROR 'Provider rejected the configured credentials (401)' with the dummy keys (EXPECTED, not counted as a failure). All 12 test-lab scenarios return 200 with correct per-step HTTP codes (invalid-signature step 401, malformed-payload step 400) and unknown scenario -> 404. Verification sweep: 247 checked, 0 verified_recovered, 247 pending, provider_reconciled 0 — never claims recovery. FRONTEND (desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844, cookie session): /integrations renders razorpay-card with TEST MODE badge, status badge, masked-key-id 'rzp_test_********', 'Secret configured', full webhook URL + working copy-endpoint-btn; config form rejects rzp_live_ with the exact backend message toast and keeps the form open; saving the valid rzp_test_ config toasts success and keeps the key masked; integration-health tiles render real counts (events 62 / processed 60 / duplicates 4 / signature failures 13 / provider cases 25 / recovered outcomes 2); sweep-btn -> sweep-result chips; 6 requested test-lab buttons (duplicate-event, invalid-signature, out-of-order, late-success, partial-payment, replayed-old-event) all render correct HTTP/result steps in test-lab-result; disconnect-btn -> NOT CONFIGURED, key '—', test-connection + all lab buttons disabled with the amber hint, and reconfiguring through the UI form restores everything (verified by re-running a lab scenario). Dashboard: source-summary chips = SIMULATED 102 / IMPORTED 240 / TEST MODE 25; case-source-filter TEST_MODE -> 25 rows, SIMULATED -> 102, IMPORTED -> 200 (default limit); TEST_MODE case detail shows TEST MODE badge, decision replay, payment timeline and a populated Provider Events section (payment.failed + payment.captured, PROCESSED, TEST MODE, event ids, timestamps). Regression sanity: CSV ingest end-to-end (3 rows -> 2 cases created, 1 closed natural, 0 exceptions), simulator scenario-btn-2 full loop, review queue (58 awaiting approval with policy reasons), decision replay — all working. ZERO console errors on every page except one expected 400 (the intentional rzp_live_ rejection).

critical.issue: ATTRIBUTION INTEGRITY BUG: the 'executed_before' branch is NOT filtered by ATTRIBUTABLE_ACTIONS, unlike the 'executed_after' branch (line 414). Any non-customer-facing action executed before a settlement earns attribution and counts full system-recovered revenue. Reproduced twice through the REAL APIs: (1) POST /api/cases/{id}/execute {action_type:'SCHEDULED_RECHECK'} (monitoring, money_touching=false) then a captured event -> case VERIFIED_RECOVERED, attributed_action SCHEDULED_RECHECK, attribution_strength MODERATE, recovered_amount 2500.0 (expected NATURALLY_RECOVERED / NONE / 0). (2) same with ESCALATE_HUMAN (CONTROL_ACTIONS) -> VERIFIED_RECOVERED, recovered_amount 2500.0. This directly contradicts the stated spec 'only customer-facing actions attributable; monitoring actions never earn attribution' and inflates verified recovered revenue in dashboard KPIs.

minor.issue: DATA LINEAGE GAP: audit_trail is queried by case_id only, so the WEBHOOK_RECEIVED and EVENT_NORMALIZED audit records (written in routes_webhooks.process_provider_event with related.provider_event_id but no case_id, since the case does not exist yet) never surface on the case page. Case detail shows CASE_CREATED onwards only. The records DO exist in audit_events (verified). Suggest also selecting audit rows whose related.provider_event_id is in the case's provider_events, or back-fill case_id on those two audit rows after case creation.

INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_URL = 'http://localhost:8001/api/webhooks/razorpay' is hardcoded (host+port). Violates the no-hardcoded-URL/port rule and will break if the internal port changes; read it from an env var.

RACE / REAL-MONEY SAFETY (observed, not yet harmful because execution is SIMULATED): the pre-execution re-check only re-reads the CASE (status) and never re-checks whether the order now has a successful settlement. LLM analysis takes ~8s, during which a payment.captured for the same order can be ingested. Observed on lab case case_14d7700c43c0: SEND_RECOVERY_LINK was executed at 08:36:17.413 for an order whose capture was recorded at 08:36:17.419 (closure at .425 correctly downgraded it to UNCERTAIN/natural). Add an 'order already settled?' guard (payment_attempts/orders lookup) immediately before executing money-touching actions.

source filtering happens in Python after fetching up to 5000 docs, and there is no pagination — the dashboard IMPORTED chip reads 240 while the table can only ever show 200 rows (default limit). Carry-over scale/UX concern from iteration 5.

ui_bugs.issue: Minor: key-id-input is type="password" although the Razorpay Key ID is not a secret — the user cannot visually verify the value they pasted (secret/webhook-secret masking is correct).

Minor: the test-connection result banner (connResult) is not cleared when a new configuration is saved or when the integration is disconnected, so a stale 'ERROR — Provider rejected the configured credentials (401)' banner can remain visible next to a freshly saved config.

integration_issues.issue: Provider Events section renders correctly, but the audit/decision-replay timeline on the case page starts at CASE_CREATED — the WEBHOOK_RECEIVED and EVENT_NORMALIZED lineage steps required by the spec are never shown (backend audit_trail is case_id-scoped; see backend minor issue).

issues: No layout defects found — no horizontal overflow on mobile, contrast and spacing fine, badges and health grid reflow correctly.

Add a regression test for both action types.

MEDIUM: add an 'order already settled' re-check immediately before executing money-touching actions in the autopilot to close the LLM-latency race.

critical_code_review_comments: detection.py:391 vs :414 — asymmetric use of ATTRIBUTABLE_ACTIONS is the root cause of the attribution defect; the allow-list must be applied on both sides of the settlement timestamp.
routes_integrations.py:22 hardcodes host+port for the internal webhook self-call; use an environment variable.

Webhook endpoint security order (size limit -> configured secret -> raw-body constant-time HMAC -> JSON parse -> event-id idempotency) is correct and never re-serializes the body before verifying — good. Signature failures are recorded as security_events and audited without leaking the secret.
public_config()/mask_key_id() correctly return metadata only; verified no secret leaks in any API response or the DOM.
detection.py is 611 lines and now carries ingestion precedence, order re-evaluation, attribution and verification — approaching the split threshold.

rca_of_the_issue: Attribution defect: close_case_on_success splits executed actions into those executed before and after the settlement timestamp. The 'after' list is filtered by ATTRIBUTABLE_ACTIONS (customer-facing only) to decide UNCERTAIN, but the 'before' list is not filtered at all, so ANY executed action — including monitoring (SCHEDULED_RECHECK) and control (ESCALATE_HUMAN, STOP_RECOVERY) actions — becomes the attributed_action with MODERATE strength and the settlement amount is booked as system-recovered revenue. Reproduced end-to-end via POST /api/cases/{id}/execute followed by a genuinely signed payment.captured webhook. Fix: apply the ATTRIBUTABLE_ACTIONS allow-list when building executed_before (and treat non-attributable-only cases as natural recovery). Lineage gap: WEBHOOK_RECEIVED/EVENT_NORMALIZED audits are written before the case exists so they carry no case_id, while GET /api/cases/{id} filters audit_events by case_id only.
